message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide for a **public API** that accepts an IP address and returns detailed company data—including contact information when it’s available. --- ## 1. Recommended Service: **ipdata.co** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Endpoint** | `https://api.ipdata.co/?api-key=` | | **Response Fields** | `company` object containing:
• `name`, `domain`, `industry`, `size`, `type`, `description`, `logo_url`, `website_url`, `twitter_handle`, `linkedin_url`, `facebook_url`, `instagram_url`, `youtube_url`, **`phone`**, **`email`**, `address` | | **Free Tier** | 50 000 requests/month (no credit card required). | | **Rate Limit** | 200 req/minute (free tier). | | **Documentation** | https://docs.ipdata.co/ | ### Example Request ```http GET https://api.ipdata.co/8.8.8.8?api-key=YOUR_API_KEY ``` ### Example Response (truncated) ```json { "ip": "8.8.8.8", "city": "Mountain View", "region": "California", "country_name": "United States", "postal": "94035", "latitude": 37.386, "longitude": -122.0838, "company": { "name": "Google LLC", "domain": "google.com", "industry": "Internet", "size": "10000+", "type": "Public", "description": "Google LLC is an American multinational technology company.", "logo_url": "https://logo.clearbit.com/google.com", "website_url": "https://www.google.com", "twitter_handle": "@Google", "linkedin_url": "https://www.linkedin.com/company/google/", "facebook_url": "https://www.facebook.com/Google/", "instagram_url": "https://www.instagram.com/google/", "youtube_url": "https://www.youtube.com/user/Google", "phone": "+1-650-253-0000", "email": "contact@google.com", "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, United States" } } ``` > **Tip:** The `company` object is only populated if the IP belongs to a known corporate entity. For residential or public IPs, the field may be omitted or contain minimal data. --- ## 2. Alternative Options | Service | Endpoint | Contact Data Availability | |---------|----------|---------------------------| | **ipinfo.io** | `https://ipinfo.io//company.json` | Provides `name`, `domain`, `type`. No phone/email. | | **ipapi.co** | `https://ipapi.co//json/` | Includes `org` (organization name) but no direct contact fields. | | **ipwhois.io** | `https://ipwhois.app/json/` | Returns `org`, `isp`, `as`, but no contact details. | If you need richer contact info (phone, email, address), **ipdata.co** is the most comprehensive free option. --- ## 3. Quick Integration Example (Python) ```python import requests def get_company_info(ip_address, api_key): url = f"https://api.ipdata.co/{ip_address}" params = {"api-key": api_key} try: resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=10) resp.raise_for_status() data = resp.json() return data.get("company") # May be None if not available except requests.RequestException as e: print(f"Error fetching data: {e}") return None # Usage API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY_FROM_IPDATA_CO" company_data = get_company_info("8.8.8.8", API_KEY) print(company_data) ``` --- ## 4. Getting Started 1. **Sign up** at https://ipdata.co/ and obtain your API key. 2. Replace `"YOUR_API_KEY"` in the examples above. 3. Make a GET request to the endpoint with the target IP. 4. Parse the `company` object for contact details. --- ## 5. Things to Keep in Mind - **Privacy & Terms**: Always respect the privacy policy of the service provider and ensure you’re compliant with local regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.). - **Rate Limits**: Stick to the free tier limits or upgrade if you need higher throughput. - **Data Accuracy**: Corporate data is sourced from public registries and partner feeds; it may not always be up‑to‑date. --- ### Bottom Line For a single‑call API that returns company data *with* contact information (phone, email, address) when available, **ipdata.co** is the most feature‑rich free option. If you only need basic org names, `ipinfo.io` or `ipapi.co` will suffice. Happy coding!
